items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: Amir is like, 'y'all play hip-hop the best.'

ctx.x: Yeah. Because the thing I like about my band, especially the experiment band, which is different from most, because a lot of people, I’ve had smart alecks after me, “that’s been done before, what are you doin’ different?” Like well we’re one band. Like we’re one band playing hip-hop, playing jazz, and playing R&B to a very high level. To the point where the jazz cats are like, “y’all the best jazz group we’ve ever heard.” And then hip- hop, the Roots, Amir is like, “y’all play hip-hop the best.” You know what I…
So let’s give Mr. Glasper a hand.
